Container.Name: StreamTuner
Container.Overview: StreamTuner is a high-stability IPTV tuner proxy, MPEG-TS stream-repair engine, and multi-region XMLTV EPG aggregator. It ingests live M3U playlists, prevents stream drops during commercial breaks, auto-organizes channel numbering by country, and feeds a unified broadcast lineup to Jellyfin, Plex, and Emby via HDHomeRun or M3U tuner modes.

Config.Name: WebUI and HDHomeRun Port
Config.Description: Port for the StreamTuner Web Dashboard, HDHomeRun emulator, and M3U/EPG endpoints.

Config.Name: AppData Config Path
Config.Description: Persistent storage for settings.json and aggregated EPG data.
